title: Council Order 0015453: firefighting water supply for a business building; trucked-water alternative and occupancy classification error
jurisdiction: Alberta; respondent is Alberta Municipal Affairs (provincial authority); municipality and property location not named in the extracted text
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2006 (ABC 2006), as cited in the decision
document_date: 2015-10-07 (Council Order 0015453; panel signed 2015-10-22); the underlying order is dated 2015-06-16

facts.text: The appeal concerns provision of a water supply for firefighting, including documentation of how water will be delivered at a rate that meets the intent of ABC 2006; the order was issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs against a business and property owner.

The panel records that meeting ABC requirements would need water at 60 litres per second; delivering that by truck would need a rotating shuttle of six trucks and an on-scene holding tank; the only water on scene would be from responding trucks.
The building has firefighting access from all sides.
The building permit identified the occupancy as Group D office, which the panel treats as an error; the phase 3 part is single-storey and classified as F2 industrial on the basis of its construction.
The panel describes ABC as an integrated building safety system whose co-dependent systems must work together.
The operative clause states that the order is REVOKED.

limitations: Water supply for firefighting, not vehicle access; included as fire-access-adjacent. Provincial respondent and no accredited municipality, so second-priority Alberta record.
